max_drawdown_convention.note: Drawdown LEVELS are NEGATIVE: the minimum of (cumulative daily return - its running peak) in simple-return units for the return-space cells; in dollars for the ZC book. Not a fraction of a compounded peak (D542).

construction.delivery_rule: T1 delivery >= m+2 (grains), T2 next listed; T1 must survive the window
construction.stage0_disclosure: the twelve per-year H/K window returns 2011-2022, their Spearman with S/U, carry ratio and COT net short at formation, and the in-sample S/U terciles were read in D567 Stage 0

state.note: the per-window returns and the Spearman were SEEN in D567 Stage 0; the terciles are the seen cut

gate.rule: open iff the November stocks-to-use <= the median of every prior November's (>= 3 prior, fixture from 2010)

component_line.rho_with_ledger_entry: ABSENT: the MACD arm's per-session P&L series is not on disk; expected near zero by instrument and clock (a ZC calendar spread held three months vs an NQ day session)

P-1.claim: primary gross Sharpe > 0, above N1 p95; point 0.3-0.9

P-2.claim: positioned months hit >= 0.55 and median > 0; windows 2011-2022 hit >= 0.65 (seen)

P-3.claim: primary beats the always-on control per positioned day and on Sharpe

P-6a.claim: seen: Spearman(S/U, window return) 2011-2022 <= -0.3 with the tight tercile above the full

P-6b.claim: unseen: gated mean per positioned window >= ungated over the decidable windows, and hit likewise

P-7.claim: dollar book sigma over positioned sessions < $150

P-8.claim: commercial net short share falls through the window in >= 8 of 12 (2011-2022) and >= 4 of 7 in sample

P-9.claim: modelled cost < 25% of the gross positioned-month mean
